name: What is the average cost per square foot for a house addition in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: What is the average cost per square foot for a house addition in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost per square foot for a house addition in the Los Angeles area can range widely, typically from $250 to $600+, depending on several factors. These include the complexity of the design, the quality of materials selected, the scope of work (e.g., utility extensions, foundation work), and interior finishes. A second-story addition often costs more per square foot than a ground-level expansion due to structural requirements. We provide detailed, transparent bids tailored to your specific project after a thorough consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for house additions in Los Angeles typically range from $250 to $600+ per square foot, influenced by design complexity, material quality, and scope of work.
